_readme: Crisis and support resources, keyed by region code. The project owner MUST verify every entry and fill 'verified_on' before any use with real people. Entries with verified_on = null are shown with a notice. There is deliberately no default region.

resources.name: Your local emergency number
resources.notes: If you or someone else is in immediate danger, contact your local emergency services now.

resources.name: Someone you trust
resources.notes: A friend, family member, teacher or colleague. You do not have to go through this alone.

resources.name: A doctor, counsellor or other health professional
resources.notes: Especially if distress feels persistent or severe.

resources.name: Tele-MANAS (national tele mental health helpline, Ministry of Health and Family Welfare)
resources.notes: Free, 24x7, about 20 languages. A counselling and support line, not an emergency service.

resources.name: Single emergency number
resources.notes: Believed to be India's unified emergency number. NOT verified in this project: confirm before use.
